# Adapter fixtures

These pages are SYNTHETIC. They were written by hand to match the structural assumptions A1 to A7
in `src/ig-adapter.ts`. They are NOT captures of Instagram, contain no real handles, captions or
people, and use made-up class names on purpose (the adapter must not depend on them).

Passing tests prove the adapter implements its assumptions. They do not prove Instagram still
looks like this. That is what the runtime self-test is for.

Replace them with scrubbed real captures once the M0 browser experiments have run: save the
reel's container markup, replace handles, captions and codes with placeholders, keep the
structure. Never commit an unscrubbed capture.
